name: Structural Safety and Reliability
description: Probability theory: random variables and distributions, joint random variables, moments and expectation, probabilistic models for loads and resistance parameters. Structural reliability analysis: limit states, probability of failure, reliability index, performance functions, simulation methods, multiple safety factor formats, level II and III reliability methods. System reliability: elements and systems, series and parallel systems, systems with equally and unequally correlated elements. Reliability based structural design: design codes, partial safety factors, load combinations, application to structures, sensitivity analysis.
